description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ext_soap' which implements SOAP-based connector functionality in the SuiteCRM framework. It includes dependencies on other source and library files, and provides a utility method 'obj2array' for converting objects to arrays.

classes.name: ext_soap
classes.description: An abstract class implementing SOAP connector functionality, providing utility methods and serving as a base for SOAP-based connector subclasses.

methods.name: obj2array
methods.description: Converts an object or array into an associative array by recursively traversing its properties and elements.
